intro.zh: isPalindrome 判断一句话正着读和倒着读是否一样。现在 Level 和 never odd or even 都被判成“不是”。
intro.en: isPalindrome tells whether a text reads the same backwards. Today it says no to Level and to never odd or even.

zh: 不是回文的仍然返回 false。
en: Ignore upper and lower case before comparing.
What is not a palindrome still returns false.

hint.en: The clean variable in is-palindrome.js: text.toLowerCase().replaceAll(' ', '').
